card.name: First digit of numbers in doses
card.fires_on: The first digit (usually 2, 3 or 4) of a multi-digit number that starts a strength, concentration or dose, often inside parentheses after another amount. It is most common in dosing and concentration text.

modes.label: Concentration in parentheses
modes.description: The leading digit of a strength given in parentheses after a vial or volume amount.
modes.example: Each vial contains 500 mg pemetrexed per 20 mL (<<2>>5 mg/mL).

modes.label: Dose range or table value
modes.description: The leading digit of a number in a dose range or table cell.

modes.label: Radioactivity amounts
modes.description: The leading digit of an amount in mCi or MBq, often the second value in a range.
modes.example: 925 MBq to 1850 MBq (<<2>>5 mCi to 50 m

card.plain: It marks the first digit of a two-digit dose or strength number, such as the 2 in 25 mg.
